message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Li purchased two suspected firearms, sold one, kept one, lent to another. Later police found parts, assembled into two firearms, identified as self-made firearms using gunpowder, with lethal capability. So crimes: illegal possession, private manufacture, and possibly illegal sale/transfer of firearms. In Chinese criminal law, offenses: illegal possession of firearms (非法持有枪支), illegal manufacturing (非法制造枪支), illegal sale (非法买卖枪支). The examples: earlier similar case: "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药;盗窃" and "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药". Also "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药;盗窃". For this case, there is purchase, sale, possession, and assembly. So likely "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" (illegal possession, private storage of firearms and ammunition). Also "非法制造枪支" maybe. The facts mention he bought parts and assembled? Actually police assembled from parts found. He possessed parts, not necessarily manufactured. But he had self-made firearms. The law: "非法制造、买卖、运输、持有枪支、弹药" could be multiple. In examples, they used "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药". So answer: [罪名]非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药<eoa>. Possibly also "非法买卖枪支". The fact: He sold one to Li5. So illegal sale. So include "非法买卖枪支". In Chinese classification: "非法买卖、运输、非法持有枪支、弹药". So answer could be "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药;非法买卖枪支". Use semicolon. Provide final answer.
